fixes.explanation: Nope, no Egypt in this view, friend. The LORD shows Moses the land, from Gilead as far as Dan, and all the land of Judah as far as the Western Sea (Deuteronomy 34:1-2). Egypt is behind him, and the text never mentions a road back. Moses is looking at the land the LORD swore to give Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob (Deuteronomy 34:4).

Yes, baker. The text says, "So the Israelites obeyed him and did as the LORD had commanded Moses." (Deuteronomy 34:9) Joshua son of Nun was filled with the spirit of wisdom because Moses had laid his hands on him. That's a new leader taking over, and the people listened. I would love a crowd that listens like that when I say the oven is hot.

This one is true, baker. The text says no prophet performed "…all the mighty acts of power and awesome deeds that Moses did in the sight of all Israel." (Deuteronomy 34:12) Moses did those deeds in the sight of all Israel, so the whole nation saw them. The verse before it says the same about the signs and wonders in Egypt (Deuteronomy 34:11).
